protocol: Real CPU inference with Transformers.js 4.3.2 and ONNX Runtime Node. Each model used overlapping 480-token windows, 64-token overlap and a token-weighted mean. GPTTrace candidate inputs had invisible formatting stripped. The test harness does not reproduce every step of the vendor deployment.

Six genres, 48 passages each, 24 human and eight each from GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and Llama 3 70B. Source row IDs are zero-based. Chosen from passages of 80–1200 words by SHA-256 order of veritext-4.7/<id>, excluding exact duplicates.
The app language and 80-word checks abstain on three human rows. These are listed and excluded from threshold fitting and reported eligible metrics.

Thresholds selected on AcademicResearch, NewsArticle, and PersonalCommunication only. Maximize AI recall with no more than 5% observed human false flags, breaking ties by fewer false flags then higher cutoff. EducationMaterial, LiteratureCreativeWriting, and TechnicalWriting are held out from threshold selection.

The Detailed HC3 reference checks remain in the release. Its historical cutoff for an elevated result was effectively 0.9484625767186728. The mean-logit combinations were inspected as offline candidates only.

Newer TextSight figures replay the known stored scores for all 394 passages and show a separate eligible-only count. The 1B supplemental comparison uses all 56 AI rows and every sixth human row from the same known corpus. No thresholds were fit on TextSight.
Dataset labels are publisher assertions, prior training overlap is unknown, and held-out sample sizes are small. No private competitor accuracy or real-world rate is inferred.
roundedBenchmarkNote: Each scores array follows the models array order.
